content:
The Sonos iPhone app has just gained an important new feature: Live Activities. Here are the details on how it works.

Live Activities have officially arrived on the Sonos app, offering convenient lock-screen playback controls.

Sonos users have endured years of changes to the iOS app.

Following a controversial redesign that ultimately cost the CEO his job, Sonos has been slowly reintroducing features its users asked for.

Live Activities has been a long-requested feature for Sonos users, and it's finally rolling out today in the latest Sonos iPhone app update.

Here's a breakdown based on a Sonos post on Reddit:

How do Live Activities work and what do they display? Once enabled, the Live Activity will appear after you begin playback and close the app. It will display the last room or group you were playing music in. The Live Activity will disappear 15 minutes after playback stops. While iOS Live Activities can be viewed on the lock screen, you'll need to unlock your iPhone with Face ID or a passcode before you can change playback settings.

Back in February, Bloomberg reported that Sonos was preparing to add Live Activity support. It's good to see it officially launch today.

If you don't want to use Live Activities, you can turn them off in the app's settings. Sonos also noted the following limitations:

  • Live Activities currently don't display album artwork, though Sonos says it is 'looking at other ways to improve the lock-screen experience.'
  • Live Activities will also work on CarPlay and Apple Watch, but with limited functionality. Sonos says 'playback controls aren't supported at this time.'
  • If you want to start playback from somewhere other than the Sonos app — like AirPlay, Bluetooth, or a supported service — playback controls will still work.

More details can be found in this Reddit post.

If you're looking to add to your Sonos setup, you can find it on Amazon. The Sonos Move 2 is currently discounted by $100.

What do you think of Sonos' Live Activities support? Let us know in the comments.
